environment.workload: One emulator/session; no build or other benchmark started during sampling; unrelated host activity uncontrolled.

methodology.inputObserver: sequential production AndroidLocalScreenshot after API return

interpretation.capture: Production AndroidLocalScreenshot and production script Screenshot wrapper on a 1280x720 tagged native fixture. Script interval is 0.3 seconds after the previous wrapper call completes. Guard, frame verification, texture MSE and host coordination are outside API timing.
interpretation.input: Production Control wrapper. API return and sequential screenshot-confirmation endpoints share an on-device monotonic start. Confirmation starts polling after API return and includes PNG capture/decoding and barcode verification; it is not the first visible pixel or isolated input-dispatch latency.
interpretation.source: Native APK and five source files are checked against the isolated Git revision. Installed backend-file hashes describe the actual downloaded runtime; no full backend Git revision is inferred from the archive.
interpretation.scope: Synthetic fixture only; no game input or account task. Separate platform/runtime from desktop adapter measurements; not a universal speed ranking, game FPS or business-task acceptance.
interpretation.quantile: Sorted zero-based index floor(n*p), capped at n-1. All warm-ups and successful formal samples retained; no outlier removal, forced GC, confidence interval or cross-device inference.
